spans.s: Bhītara-bhaṇḍāra-adhikārin (IE 8-3; EI 28), Od̤iyā; Sanskrit Abhyantara-bhāṇḍār-ādhikārin, ‘officer in charge of the inner store-house or treasury (i. e. one within the palace or the harem)’.
bhītara-navara (EI 28), Od̤iyā = Sanskrit abhyantara-nagara; the palace.
bhitti-citra, wall-painting (Journ. Mad. Univ., Vol. XXXII, p. 141).
Bhitvaramānya (IA 17), probably, a mistake for Abhitva-ramāṇa (q. v.).
